scope: In-memory HTTP requests and mocked runtime; no browser, network, signing or native effect.

checks.name: host capability origin and JSON content type are required before runtime access
oversized malformed and non-object bodies cannot dispatch an operation
only explicit HTTP routes dispatch and there is no arbitrary command endpoint
preview dispatch does not confirm sign or change its request fields
explicit confirmation status and health routes call only their named runtime method
static delivery preserves browser protections and errors redact provider payloads
